# FRONTA
> Websites and apps, built right.

FRONTA is a freelance design and frontend practice — building production-ready websites and apps for founders, product teams, and engineering.

## Practices
- Marketing sites & landing pages
- Product UI, dashboards & internal tools

## Standard
- Tested thoroughly
- Opinionated
- Performance-aware
- Built for the handoff
